0022600099.text: The Bulls (0-1) visit the Bucks (0-1) for Chicago's second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams one game back in the Central, Chicago in fifth and Milwaukee in fourth. The Bulls have lost their only game so far, a road defeat, and Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury. In the 2025-26 season series, Chicago lost 1-3 to Milwaukee, but the Bulls won 120-97 in Chicago in their most recent meeting on March 1, 2026.
